cases.prompt: Check this refactor for behavior change. Public contract (docs): sortByDueDate returns tasks by dueDate ascending, with tasks without a due date last. Before: `tasks.sort((a, b) => (a.dueDate ?? Infinity) - (b.dueDate ?? Infinity))`. After: `tasks.sort(compareNullable('dueDate'))`, where compareNullable returns -1 when a[key] is null. Supported domain: arrays of up to 10,000 tasks; dueDate is an epoch-millisecond number or null. Baseline observation: input [{id:1,dueDate:null},{id:2,dueDate:5}] returned ids [2,1].
